# 1. Summary and Setup

## Software and files

:::: { .columns }

::: { .column width="60%" }

- University PC: use `OpenRefine` (Start Menu)
- Own computer: Download and install OpenRefine
  - [https://openrefine.org/download](https://openrefine.org/download)
  - Manual: [https://docs.openrefine.org/](https://docs.openrefine.org/)

::: { .callout-important }
- You will need to download some files to follow this lesson
  - [https://datacarpentry.github.io/OpenRefine-ecology-lesson/data/Portal_rodents_19772002_simplified.csv](https://datacarpentry.github.io/OpenRefine-ecology-lesson/data/Portal_rodents_19772002_simplified.csv)

:::

# 2. Exploring data

## Challenge (3min)

::: { .panel-tabset }

## Problem

::: { .callout-warning title="Use faceting to answer these questions"}
1. How many years are represented in the census
2. Which years have the most and least observations
3. Is the year column formatted as `Number`, `Date`, or `Text`?
:::

## Solution

::: { .callout-warning title="Use faceting to answer these questions"}
1. How many years are represented in the census
2. Which years have the most and least observations
3. Is the year column formatted as `Number`, `Date`, or `Text`?
:::

::: { .callout-tip title="Solution"}
1. 16
2. Most: 1978 (237), least: 1993 (1)
3. `Text`
:::
